## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (it becomes the commit subject on `main`)
- [ ] Every `Command` argument is a compile-time literal; no request data reaches argv
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, or secret files committed
- [ ] Destructive tools keep their `confirm: true` gate
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated (or not needed)
